Compares two rasters, their grids and their values cell by cell.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Compare, Difference, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterCompare`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster1` | raster file |  |  | The first raster. |
| `inRaster2` | raster file |  |  | The second raster. |
| `pTolerance` | double |  | `0` | The largest difference of two values seen as equal (default 0). |
| `pMaxReported` | int |  | `10` | The number of different cells listed in the report (default 10). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outSameGrid` | Boolean |  | True if the rasters have the same grid, and so their values were compared. |
| `outDifferent` | Long |  | The number of cells with different values, novalue in one raster only included. |
| `outMaxDifference` | Double |  | The max absolute difference of the cells valid in both rasters. |
